name: Yamaha PW50 (Pee Wee)
engine: 49 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, carb, automatic, shaft drive
intro: The kids' bike most riders started on. Two-stroke with oil injection, automatic, and shaft drive.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.
B: Set the throttle limiter screw for the rider's skill before the first ride.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.
